## Specific task description

Task instruction: Secure both items simultaneously, holding the handheld scanner near the tea box with green leaves for scanning.

Task description: Hold both the black-and-gray handheld scanner at the front left of the table and the yellow tea box at the front right, positioning the scanner end near and facing the tea box to create a scannable relative pose.

Success criteria: The tea box must be very close in front of the scanning end, with the scan direction aimed at its body and minimal deviation from the scan axis. Both grippers must remain closed, securely holding scanner and box separately.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the straight, narrow handle section behind the broad scanner head, with the pads against both sides of the handle. Avoid the handle tip and the sloped junction with the head to reduce rotation and leave the scanning end clear.
- Grasp flat areas on opposite sides of the tea box, away from corners and the seam in the lid, leaving the face toward the scanner unobstructed.
- Open slightly wider than the selected grasp section and confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides before closing. If they only overlap in the image, adjust position or viewpoint slightly to avoid one-finger pushing.
- Adjust orientation in an open area above the table, leaving room for scan-head and gripper rotation. During close alignment, keep the tea box steady and adjust the scanner's position and angle slightly, avoiding a nearby casing whose scanning direction still passes beside the box.
